header: Country-agnostic ERP core; initial deployment profile is UAE. Do not assume India, INR or GST.

records.Country-agnostic ERP core; initial deplo: GST is not mandatory. Use generic tax types; configure UAE VAT only after SEVENTS finance/tax owners confirm registration status, treatment and applicable rules.
Country/legal entity/project configuration should hold jurisdiction, currency, language, timezone, fiscal calendar, statutory identifiers, invoice fields and supported localization-pack version.
Do not invent tax rates, legal deadlines, SLA values or approval limits. Unknowns must remain TBD and block consequential activation where appropriate.
Country-agnostic architecture does not automatically guarantee compliance in every country; new statutory calculations, reports, integrations or expert reviews may still be required.

records.SEVENTS Jurisdiction Architecture: SEVENTS Construction ERP — Work Item Configuration Review Workbook

records.Country-agnostic ERP core; initial deplo: Preserve the original 1,308 work-item rows and add a separate review/configuration layer. Blank review columns are intentionally not guessed.
Source catalogue is configuration input, not a list of 1,308 software features. Build reusable capabilities and map items to them.
Actionable recurring work that fits supported workflow capabilities.
A decision with inputs, authorized approver, recorded outcome and follow-up.
Filing, signature, renewal, paper step, or evidence obligation.
Scheduled review with a defined cadence, output and exception path.
Broad responsibility or guidance without a discrete task outcome.
Ambiguous, overlapping, inconsistent or dependent item requiring process-owner review.
Valid work not needed for the current delivery phase.
Trigger; responsible canonical role; action/capability; output/evidence; SLA/timing; handoff/dependency; exception/escalation; approval/risk/agent policy.
Governance Understanding, Governance Inputs for SOP Creation, and reviewer columns remain reference/provenance by default.
Do not infer or invent. Mark SLA Confirmed only after the owner confirms the timing rule and business calendar.
Map raw role labels to canonical Role IDs. Raw role names are not permission grants.
Create tasks only where a record, decision, obligation, measurable outcome or follow-up exists. Track physical signature/custody evidence where needed; do not assume scan equals valid e-signature.
No row becomes executable until the required fields are validated, risk and approval policies are set, and an authorized process owner approves publication.
